items.title: CVS (NYSE:CVS) Opens Pharmacy Focused Stores And Brings Kate Farms Nationwide
items.summary: CVS Health opened new pharmacy focused CVS Pharmacy locations in smaller, neighborhood formats across the United States. The company began offering the Kate Farms High Protein Nutrition Shake on shelves nationwide in CVS stores. These moves expand CVS Health's physical footprint and its presence in the wellness and nutrition category. CVS Health (NYSE: CVS) is adding fresh operational moves on top of a strong recent share price run. The stock trades at $109.34 and is up 36.5% year to date,...
